a2.title: Reduce Quorum to 10%, Give VETO and Early Execution Authority to Committee Multisig
a2.description:
With the move to DAODAO it is time to get PixeLions back into action. As a first step in laying the groundworks for the next phase, we propose reducing quorum to 10% and  allowing the multisig established in LionDAO prop "Establishing Lion Committee Multsig and ROAR Spend" to be given VETO and early execution authority. This will decrease governance requirements whilst safeguarding against any malicious props as well as speed up vote time once quorum has been met.

The members of this multisig are: Llew, Kiruse, Usaf, Bobo and Speerbot

a10.title: Strategic Treasury Allocation to Eris LPs for NFT Stakers
a10.description:
Proposal: Allocation of 50% of PixeLions DAO Treasury to Eris Protocol for NFT Staker Rewards

Proposal Summary
This proposal seeks to utilize 50% of the PixeLions DAO treasury to deposit into the Eris Protocol, aiming to generate returns that will be distributed among the PixeLions NFT stakers. This move is intended to increase engagement, provide passive income opportunities, and potentially enhance the value and attractiveness of holding PixeLions NFTs.

Background
PixeLions DAO: A community-driven entity with a treasury that has been built from NFT sales, and other revenue streams.
Eris Protocol: A yield-bearing platform where assets can be staked to earn rewards. Known for its stability and attractive yield rates, offering a secure method to grow deposited funds.

Objectives
Enhance Staker Rewards: By leveraging the Eris Protocol, we aim to offer a new revenue stream for our NFT stakers, increasing the utility and value of PixeLions NFTs.

Financial Growth: Utilize a portion of the treasury in a way that could potentially yield higher returns than traditional holding or other yield farming options.

Community Engagement: Encourage more active participation from community members by providing tangible financial benefits linked directly to their NFT holdings.

Proposal Details
Action Plan:
Allocation: Transfer 50% of the current PixeLions DAO treasury to the Eris Protocol for staking (specifically the Roar/AmpRoar  and the Luna/Roar LP pools).

Distribution of Returns: All returns generated from the stake in Eris Protocol will be distributed to NFT stakers based on their staking period and amount weekly. 

Duration: Initially, the commitment to the Eris Protocol would be for a period of 12 months, with performance reviews every quarter to assess the efficacy of this strategy.

Risk Management:
Quarterly performance reviews to decide on modifications or withdrawal if necessary.

Benefits
Increased Utility of NFTs: Staking becomes not only about governance but also about earning potential.
Stability and Growth: Eris Protocol's established track record can provide a stable return on investment.
Attraction for New Members: This initiative could attract more NFT enthusiasts to the PixeLions community by offering economic incentives.

Conclusion
By investing in the Eris Protocol, we aim to not only safeguard our treasury but also actively use it to benefit our community members. This proposal aligns with our goals of enhancing community value and engagement through innovative financial strategies.


[End of Proposal]
